pre_condition: proj_dir is a string path to an existing project directory.
post_condition: When the CodeGraph backend can index the project's Go code, returns a dict whose keys are canonicalized caller FQNs (using :: as the namespace separator) and whose values are sets of canonicalized callee FQNs, representing the call-graph edges for Go source files in the project. When the CodeGraph backend is unavailable, returns None.
